request.task: Final focused architecture audit for the OneBox guided pipeline mode
request.head: e43513363384c3583034c0505c91184535918ef1

findings.scenario: The matrix is 'evaluated top-to-bottom' while also saying durable terminals/errors take precedence, but complete/cost-cap/lifecycle/fallback rows sit below a weakly predicated `scanned=done, market analysis ready` row whose primary action is Continue automatically. After scan, that row matches for the rest of the run (including `complete`, cost-cap, reference-paused, locked/synthesized/built, evidence pauses). A first-match implementer never reaches later guided surfaces; a complete run would show Understanding the leaders instead of Website ready. This reopens the Grok BLOCK that known controller states must actually be selectable, not merely listed.
findings.remediation: Make rows mutually exclusive current-checkpoint matches. Evaluate durable terminals/errors/human pauses first (complete, stage failed, cost cap, evidence/reference/source/visual pauses, parked/fallback). Treat market-analysis.json only as step-2 availability (reopenable after scan), with a current-surface predicate such as `scanned=done AND locked not started AND no later stage/terminal`. Keep unknown-state fail-closed only after those exclusive predicates miss.

audit.proof_assessment: The draft text does close the Grok BLOCK/HIGH contract items: untagged historical selection remains a first-class parse arm with in-memory normalize only; ranked records keep rank-1 `selectedId`/`selectionKind`/`version`/`note`; new runs set immutable `referencePickerEnabled=true` independent of view; analysis lives in additive `market-analysis.json` (scan.json stays max-4); rubric inputs strip directory popularity fields; `at`/`checkpointId`/`sourceMode`/`fingerprint` are server-derived; ReferenceLock `preferenceLedger` is optional and Page IR uses the same rank1-primary / rank2–3-supporting normalizer. Grok MEDIUMs on research status and Page IR bounds are also written closed. Deterministic proof (`finalizeReferenceLock` requiring `selectedId`, `ScanResultSchema` not shown but cited max-4, picker default false) still justifies those closures as spec, not as implemented code. The remaining MEDIUM+ defect is the §5.4 matching rule, which makes the enumerated surfaces unreachable under the stated evaluation order.
residual_risks: Two-step persist-then-POST `/api/run` crash window; reconnect must resume from `status=selected` with no second confirm.
Home still passing the event timeline into GuidedPipeline unless tests forbid event-card oracles.
Research-disabled / non-refero runs are not an exclusive matrix row; they could still fail closed to Review required.
Evidence-workspace picker vs guided `select-ranked` must 409 in both directions as the only cross-mode lock.
Canonical first-party vs directory/social URL eligibility still has no deterministic classifier.
